summary: The Jansky Fellowship is a postdoctoral fellowship in radio astronomy offered by the National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) in the United States. It is aimed at researchers moving into a postdoctoral role, with a nominal start in September 2027 and a start no later than January 2028. The listing does not state the host city.
